nodes.name: CALM User
nodes.description: User working with CALM architectures through various tools and interfaces

nodes.name: CALM CLI
nodes.description: Command-line interface for CALM operations including validation, generation, visualization, and documentation

nodes.name: VSCode Extension
nodes.description: Visual Studio Code extension providing IDE integration for CALM architectures with syntax highlighting, validation, and visualization

nodes.name: CalmStudio
nodes.description: Browser-based visual CALM architecture editor (SvelteKit) for creating and editing architectures with built-in CALM 1.2 validation

nodes.name: CALM Server
nodes.description: Standalone HTTP server exposing CALM architecture validation as a REST API, independent of the CALM Hub

nodes.name: CALM Hub API
nodes.description: Central registry and API service for CALM architectures, patterns, and standards built with Quarkus

nodes.name: CALM Hub UI
nodes.description: React-based web interface for browsing and managing CALM architectures, patterns, and standards

nodes.name: MongoDB
nodes.description: Document database for storing CALM architectures, patterns, and standards in CALM Hub

nodes.name: CALM Hub System
nodes.description: Complete CALM Hub system including API backend, web UI, and database

nodes.name: Visual Studio Code
nodes.description: Microsoft Visual Studio Code IDE

nodes.name: Git Repository
nodes.description: Local commit history of CALM JSON files and co-changed Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).

nodes.name: Git History Extractor
nodes.description: Traverses git log --follow -M30% locally across one or multiple Git repositories and extracts valid JSON snapshots plus co-changed ADRs.

nodes.name: Multi-Repo Federation Engine
nodes.description: Synchronizes chronological commits across repositories, enforces strict peer namespace isolation, and merges shared boundary nodes solely through details.detailed-architecture.

nodes.name: FINOS TraderX State Importer
nodes.description: Converts upstream finos/traderx progressive state catalogs (States 001-014 including FINOS FDC3 interoperability), ADRs, and Git commits into validated CALM 1.3 architectures and timelines.

nodes.name: Structural Diff Engine
nodes.description: Canonicalizes CALM documents and filters formatting/noise commits from genuine structural deltas.

nodes.name: Commit Diff Digest Exporter
nodes.description: Emits compact, deterministic <arch>.digest.json summaries with embedded clustering schema for optional review by approved IDE AI assistants.

nodes.name: Deterministic & Spec Clusterer
nodes.description: Groups contiguous structural commits into architectural moments via deterministic heuristics or validated --clusters <clusters.json> specifications.

nodes.name: CALM Timeline Emitter
nodes.description: Emits CALM 1.3 calm-timeline.json documents and immutable Git-backed moment architecture snapshots.

nodes.name: Timelapse Stage SVG Renderer
nodes.description: Computes layered super-graph coordinates and renders the interactive single-viewport SVG Timelapse Stage with zoom/pan, blast-radius focus, and as-of date queries.

nodes.name: Architecture Feed Renderer
nodes.description: Renders architectural moments in reverse chronological order (Latest First, N -> 1) as scrollable story cards pairing auto-cropped SVG diagrams, narrative summaries, change/ADR chips, and standalone SVG export.

nodes.name: IDE AI Assistant (Optional)
nodes.description: Enterprise-approved coding assistant (Copilot, Claude Code, Kiro, Codex, Bob, OpenCode) that optionally reads <arch>.digest.json and writes <arch>.clusters.json in the workspace.

nodes.name: Architect / Reviewer
nodes.description: Explores architectural evolution frame-by-frame with as-of compliance dates, baseline diffing, and ADR provenance.

nodes.name: REST Resources Layer
nodes.description: JAX-RS resource classes under org.finos.calm.resources exposing namespace-scoped endpoints for architectures, patterns, controls, ADRs, decorators, domains, flows, interfaces, standards, timelines, search, and user access

nodes.name: Services Layer
nodes.description: Business logic under org.finos.calm.services that orchestrates store access on behalf of the REST resources layer

nodes.name: Storage Layer
nodes.description: Store abstraction under org.finos.calm.store, with CDI producers that select a MongoDB or NitriteDB implementation at runtime based on the calm.database.mode configuration property

nodes.name: NitriteDB
nodes.description: Embedded, file-based document database used in standalone and read-only deployment modes (calm.database.mode=standalone), avoiding the need for an external database

flows.name: [FINOS CALM Core] Publish Architecture
flows.description: User authors and publishes a CALM architecture to the Hub via the CLI

transitions.description: User invokes the CLI to publish an architecture
CLI sends the architecture to the CALM Hub API over HTTPS
CALM Hub API persists the architecture in MongoDB

flows.name: [FINOS CALM Core] Browse Architectures
flows.description: User browses published architectures through the CALM Hub web UI

transitions.description: User opens the CALM Hub UI in a browser
Hub UI fetches architecture data from the Hub API
Hub API queries MongoDB for stored architectures

flows.description: User validates a CALM architecture directly inside VS Code using the extension

transitions.description: User opens a CALM file in VS Code and triggers validation

flows.description: User or automated pipeline validates a CALM architecture by calling CALM Server's REST API

transitions.description: Caller POSTs an architecture to CALM Server's /calm/validate endpoint and receives validation results

calm-timelapse--zero-network-execution.description: [CALM Timelapse] Guarantees that calm-timelapse executes 100% offline with zero embedded HTTP clients, LLM SDKs, or external runtime network calls.

config.name: Zero-Network Deterministic CLI Execution
config.description: Forbids outbound HTTP/LLM calls inside the CLI so regulated air-gapped CI pipelines run deterministically without credentials.

calm-timelapse--contiguous-cluster-cover.description: [CALM Timelapse] Validates any external --clusters JSON specification to ensure contiguous, non-overlapping coverage of structural commits 0..N-1 while sourcing every architecture snapshot strictly from Git.

config.name: Contiguous Commit Coverage & Git Snapshot Integrity
config.description: Enforces validateClusterSpecs(0..N-1) so external AI assistants cannot drop commits, overlap ranges, or hallucinate CALM JSON snapshots.

calm-timelapse--strict-peer-namespace-is.description: [CALM Timelapse] Prevents unintended node merging across unlinked peer repositories while permitting canonical composition and boundary-node merging when explicitly linked via details.detailed-architecture.

config.name: Peer Namespace Isolation & Detailed-Architecture Resolution
config.description: Namespaces unlinked nodes per source (<sourceId>--<id>) and merges shared nodes only across resolved details.detailed-architecture edges.
